content: Self-training with a fixed confidence threshold and fixed already-adopted pseudo-labels. Objects: true-labeled set L (fixed), unlabeled candidate pool U→remaining pool R, adopted pseudo-label set A (initially empty), current model. Initial supervised train on L→model→predict R→confidence filter with fixed τ. If accepted examples exist, move those samples out of R into A, keep their predicted labels distinguishable from true targets; then RETRAIN on L+A FIRST; only updated model predicts next R. If pool empty, no candidates pass, or round limit reached, terminate with model that has trained on the last adopted batch. Draw the actual adoption/move and retraining feedback loop, not human annotation. No augmentations required in this textbook variant; attached FixMatch diagram is only for confidence/pseudo-label mechanism, don't copy its weak/strong-view consistency branches. Labels are model predictions, do not imply true labels or human confirmed labels. Use true target filled markers vs pseudo-target outline markers, concise clear nodes and sample pool visual tokens, label slots inside nodes.
prompt:
Original academic ML textbook diagram, fresh independently chosen layout. Attached references are newly selected external source material ONLY to understand mechanism/object; do not copy layouts/colors/text. Entire PNG artwork UNLABELLED: no text, digits, symbols, equation glyphs, fake marks, watermark. Pure white canvas, flat 2D, fine neutral outlines and directional arrows with exact endpoints. White nodes with colored outlines plus selective constant pale flat fills, no ornamental icons/cards. Semantic palette Blue #7B95C6, Cyan #49C2D9, Green #67A583, Orange #F59C7C, Rose #C85E62. A given object/group has one main color. Uniform constant fill inside a continuous shape, no gradient, ripple, texture, grain, mottled areas, noise, 3D, shadow, halo or glow. Mechanism images/grids/dots/tree structures preferred over generic empty boxes. Leave sufficient whitespace for short Chinese labels and formulas to be rendered later in actual fonts; no overall title. Topology exactly as specified.
